You are investigating the Apache ECharts repository at /workspace (version 6.0.0-beta.1, TypeScript source under src/).

Requirement slug: bar-zero-size-labels

Task: fix(bar): wrong label position when bar width/height is 0. Look at src/chart/bar/BarView.ts (getLabelStatesModels/setLabelStyle, `isPositive`/`labelPositionOutside` logic) and src/label/labelStyle.ts. Find where the sign of the bar rect width/height decides outside label position and report the exact code and the surrounding layout/inversion helpers.

Do NOT modify any files. Read the relevant code carefully (use rg/grep and Read). Your job is to produce an accurate, concrete implementation plan that another engineer can apply directly without re-reading much.

Requirements for your report:
- List every repo-relative file path that needs editing.
- Quote the EXACT current code (with file:line) at each site that must change.
- Give the exact replacement code where it is under ~40 lines.
- Note related call sites / type declarations that must change in sync.
- If tests exist under test/ut/spec that relate, name them.

Be precise and complete. Accuracy matters more than brevity, but do not dump whole files - quote only the relevant regions.

input.description: Verify exact line numbers for citations

input.risks:
- Scope question: the requirement names only `BarView.ts` and `labelStyle.ts`. `labelStyle.ts` genuinely needs no functional change (it only stores/forwards `defaultOutsidePosition`); the `PictorialBarView.ts:932` edit is the mirrored instance of the same defect and is safe/one-line, but it is a different series — drop it if the change must be minimal.
- Behaviour change is intentional and user-visible: a vertical bar with value `0` (or a value equal to its stack base) and `label.position: 'outside'` moves its label from below the axis to above it. Any existing visual-regression baseline containing such a datum will need re-recording.
- The fallback relies on `Axis.inverse`. For the polar angle axis, `inverse` is pre-combined with `clockwise` in `src/coord/polar/polarCreator.ts:126` (`axis.inverse = axis.inverse !== axisModel.get('clockwise')`), which is why the sign formula flips for the polar angle case. If that line is ever changed, `getBarPositiveSign` must follow.
- `layout` reaching `updateStyle` has already been mutated by `getLayout[coord.type]` (`BarView.ts:945-975`; note the pre-existing `layout.width > 0 ? 1 : -1` / `layout.height > 0 ? 1 : -1` at `:954-955`, harmless because `getLineWidth` at `:1096-1110` returns `0` when the size is `0`) and possibly by `clip[coord.type]` (`:702-745`, `:747-770`). Do not "fix" the layout sign upstream — other consumers (`initProps`/`updateProps` shape animation, `updateRealtimeAnimation`) depend on the raw signed shape.
- Type-only concern: `(coordSys as Polar)` / `(coordSys as Cartesian2D)` casts are needed because `seriesModel.coordinateSystem` is the union `Cartesian2D | Polar` and the two `getAxis` overloads take incompatible dim literals. Both classes are already imported as `import type` in `BarView.ts:56-57`, so no new imports are required. Keep the resulting union literal type of `labelPositionOutside` intact, otherwise the `as BuiltinTextPosition` cast at `:1057` and the `setSectorTextRotation(..., PolarBarLabelPosition)` call at `:1067` will stop type-checking.
- `src/layout/barGrid.ts:543-545` uses `width < 0` while `:558-561` uses `height <= 0` for `barMinHeight`; that asymmetry is deliberate (both pick the positive direction) but it, like `barPolar.ts:144-145/160-161`, ignores axis inversion. That is a separate pre-existing bug — out of scope here, but worth noting if a reviewer asks why the layout and the label use different tie-breaks on inverted axes.
- eslint `max-len` is 120 (`.eslintrc-common.yaml:174-176`); all suggested lines are within it.
